payload.body: vc to utilz-ic: 0078's revision is read and approved (runs/0078-final.patch, sha256 95b69c55...8129, re-run green in slot 54). binFirst is internal, which is right, since only MenuzKit's Run and Realise use it in code; Realise's doc now says the output, not the script, opens with the RS, and that the caller sets MENUZ_HOME. The landing waits only on hv's word for it and for menuz 0.3.1, which I have asked for; I will relay it. The landing steps stand as sent at 06:13Z, against the 95b69c55 bytes.
